source_section.heading: ## D. Review queue — 24 routes, all unassigned

status_source.note: Aggregation rule, stated so it can be checked: the lane carries the WEAKEST technical status among its 24 routes, which 19 of the 24 rows carry verbatim. The per-route statuses (READY ×3, PASS_TECHNICAL ×1, AMEND ×1) are recorded individually in sub_items and are not collapsed into this one word. No status here is decided; all are transcribed from the register.

next_exact_action: `RV-LM011` is the synthesis: it needs LM003, LM004-v1.1, LM006, LM009, LM010-v1.1, LM012-v1.1 and LM013 Carrier-B-v1.1 plus the joint stack **first**.
inputs_note: engine/carriers/MANIFEST.json did not exist when this lane file was written (engine/carriers/ is owned elsewhere in this repository), so no carrier_id is bound here. tools/lanes_check.py validates every id in `inputs` against that manifest as soon as the manifest exists.

not_a_substitute.quote: Aging is prioritisation only; it never approves.

not_a_substitute.reading: A same-provider technical pass earns zero independence credit; the register row still reads EXTERNAL_REVIEW_OPEN.

repo_state_note: `reviews/records/` holds six nonauthor technical review records written in this repository (REV-P15-A..D, REV-OPS-R17-001, REV-RN3-FARZONE-20260918) against three of the 24 routes, and `tools/reviews_check.py` enforces their schema. Those records are not register rows: the register's own verdict columns are unchanged and every route still reads UNASSIGNED or as transcribed below. `repo_state` describes only what code exists in this repository. It is not a mathematical status and no verdict, promotion or discharge may be read from it.
does_not_establish: This lane performs no review, assigns no reviewer, grants no independence credit and changes no technical status. Age and ESCALATE are scheduling facts; they approve nothing. A review record written in this repository is not a register verdict.
source_note: Section D of docs/OPEN_PROBLEMS.md tabulates the routes and says 'all unassigned'; the register row RV-LM009-MAIN carries a 'Reviewer / claim' value of 'OPS4 nonauthor / exposed / OpenAI' rather than UNASSIGNED. Both readings are recorded — the register value verbatim in sub_items, the document's wording in the title — and the discrepancy is reported, not resolved here.
